description: On a misty country road in the rain, dogs in hard hats and high-visibility vests work on an old cream bus with its bonnet open. One dog in a yellow hat lies on a mechanic's creeper and reaches a spanner towards an engine block on a tarp. One in a white hat stands on a metal lifting rig whose chain holds up the engine, and another in a yellow hat shines a small lamp. More dogs sit on the roof and in the driver's seat. Tools lie on the tarp, and a young woman with an umbrella watches.
